name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandPrimeChain.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of the complete common-prime chain
natural_language_statement:
Let $s>0$, positive band size $g$, chain depth $K$, prime bound $Y$ and maximum intermediate modulus $M$ be natural numbers. Suppose memory retains original integer arrays A,B,C bounded by $U$, Boolean physical owner records with all flagged band starts in range, and $s$ distinct auxiliary primes $p_i\le Y$, all before free address $f$. Assume $Y^{K+1}\le M$, addresses fit words, the exact chain-space and aggregate-score word bounds fit and depth $d+\lceil\log_2M\rceil+8$ is allowed. Then the fixed prime-chain program writes each recursively selected common modulus $q_j$ for $0\le j\le K$ at $f+j$, returns

$$q_K,$$

meets its prescribed full-chain time and preserves every cell below $f$. Here the sequence $q_j$ is the deterministic modulus chain defined by the exact aggregate band-owner weighted score.

This executes every common-modulus choice while retaining the complete chain for the later false-score bound.
explanation: This executes every common-modulus choice while retaining the complete chain for the later false-score bound.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceBatchStep.Procs.meets
theorem_title: Execution of one retained paired-source bank slot
natural_language_statement:
Let finite decidable types carry sets B,C with integer maps and bijective physical array enumerations of lengths $N_L,N_R$. Fix $h,J$, cutoff $c\le W=J\cdot464h$, arithmetic modulus $p$, signed shift $\delta$, global output $q$, bank count $N$ and slot $i<N$. Suppose memory stores its exact occurrence row, selected-cover maps/candidate indices/bucket counts and both original-value source histograms modulo the block-source modulus; left uses zero shift and right uses $\delta$. All these retained arrays end before batch base $b$. Assume addresses fit words, the exact retained-host space bound at the computed batch work pointer and word bound for $(N_L,N_R,h,J)$ fit, and depth $d+W+10$ is allowed. With the literal step closure, the program constructs all left/right source-zeta stages in slot $i$, writes their two computed bases at $b+2i,b+2i+1$, meets its stated time, and preserves cells below the slot payload except those two pointer cells.

This fills one reusable occurrence-indexed source-bank entry from the same original input histograms.
explanation: This fills one reusable occurrence-indexed source-bank entry from the same original input histograms.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingSuffixQueryIndexed.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of the exact original raw-prefix query
natural_language_statement:
Let finite decidable index types have finite sets A,B,C and integer maps $a,b,c$. Fix integer modulus/shift $p,\delta$, $h,J,k$ with $k\le J$, wanted label $w$ and a valid depth-$k$ prefix $u$. Assume $w_A\in A$ and its lifted A residue plus $\delta$ agrees with the output key modulo the global modulus. Let global width $W$, residual query size $r$, suffix stage $V$, switch $t\le r+1$ and box cutoff $b\le r$ satisfy $r-t\le b$. Suppose memory stores the exact complete original left/right source transforms and local box stages for $(w,u)$, all ending before a query-mask buffer of its prescribed capacity, itself before Pascal/power scratch. Assume addresses fit words, $(W+1)2^{W+1}$ and the exact signed-query magnitude bound fit, sufficient scratch fits memory, and depth $d+W+10$ is allowed. The fixed suffix-query host returns

$$\operatorname{prefixQuery}(\operatorname{rawOn}(A\times B\times C),w,k,u),$$

within its stated time and preserves cells below scratch outside the mask buffer.

This is the machine-to-combinatorics bridge for exact positive-frontier decisions.
explanation: This is the machine-to-combinatorics bridge for exact positive-frontier decisions. The returned integer is the unchanged original raw-prefix count, which determines the next positive reporting frontier.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingSuffixSetup.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of complete suffix-local box preprocessing
natural_language_statement:
Let global width $W$, suffix width $V$, offset $a$ satisfy $a+V\le W$. Fix source cutoff $c\le W$, box cutoff $b\le V$, stage $s\le W$, prefixes $P_L,P_R$ with $|P_L|+b,|P_R|+b\le c$, and integer subset functions $f,g$ bounded by $B,D$ through cutoff $c$. Suppose their full source transforms end before box base; the $(V+1)D(V,b)$ box stages end before a length-$D(V,b)$ mask buffer, itself before scratch. Assume addresses fit words, Pascal/power scratch fits, $(W+1)2^{W+1}$ and $2^V(2^sB)(2^sD)$ fit words, and depth $d+W+11$ is allowed. The fixed setup constructs every local box stage of the signed lifted-source leaf function, retains both original source transforms, meets its stated time and preserves cells below the mask base outside the box payload.

This preprocesses residual-width canonical boxes from actual source reads, including construction of the lift factor.
explanation: This preprocesses residual-width canonical boxes from actual source reads, including construction of the lift factor.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingTerminalStored.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of terminal scanning from a retained frontier slot
natural_language_statement:
Let $I$ be a finite raw-incidence set over finite decidable types, $w$ a wanted label and $k\le J$ a depth. Suppose memory stores its exact frontier slot and root capacity, original B/C arrays, their correct two-modulus buckets, cover tables and output occurrence row. All retained arrays and the frontier slot end before terminal masks. Reserve in order the enumeration masks, two full endpoint-mask arrays, complete endpoint/flag preparation payload, a width-$J\cdot464h$ bit row, two row cells and scratch. Assume each reservation ends before the next, exact terminal space/word bounds fit, addresses fit words, originals/A value/target sums and $N_LN_R$ fit words, and depth includes frontier length, candidate count, global width and eleven overhead calls. The fixed adapter loads the slot metadata and returns a Boolean with

$$r=1\iff\exists u\in\operatorname{frontier}(I,w,k):\operatorname{TerminalHit}(u),$$

within its prescribed actual frontier time, preserving all cells below the terminal-mask base.

This executes the final exact-value scan over precisely the stored positive frontier.
explanation: This executes the final exact-value scan over precisely the stored positive frontier. The retained slot count and mask pointers determine the entire scan order and its exact original-value hit condition.
